note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Servers are started hidden by prepare (helper C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1) and their logs are shown with Get-Content/Select-String. Uses the episode 11 services (built and started from ..\11-microservices-with-net) as backend. The MAUI workload and the Android SDK with an x64 emulator image are not on the laptop yet (LAB.md): install them before this recording. The emulator reaches the backend as http://10.0.2.2:5311.
prepare: if (-not ((dotnet workload list) -match 'maui')) { dotnet workload install maui }  # needs an elevated shell, once

$sdk = if ($env:ANDROID_HOME) { $env:ANDROID_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk' }; $emu = Join-Path $sdk 'emulator\emulator.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $emu)) { throw 'Android SDK emulator not found: install the Android SDK and an x64 AVD first' }; $adb = Join-Path $sdk 'platform-tools\adb.exe'; if (-not (& $adb devices | Select-String 'emulator-\d+\s+device')) { $avd = (& $emu -list-avds | Select-Object -First 1); if (-not $avd) { throw 'No Android Virtual Device (x64 image) found' }; Start-Process $emu -ArgumentList '-avd', $avd, '-no-snapshot-save'; & $adb wait-for-device; do { Start-Sleep 3 } until ((& $adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed) -match '1') }

screens.name: request-list
screens.app: Contoso Requests (MAUI app on Windows) next to a PowerShell window
steps: Make sure the Episode 11 services are up (prepare did it); POST one request first: Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:5311/api/requests -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{ title='Laptops for the lab'; departmentCode='IT'; amount=9000; requestedBy='alex.demo@contoso.com' } | ConvertTo-Json)
Start the app: dotnet build src/Contoso.Mobile -f net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0 -t:Run
Show the request list with its budget states (IT 9,000 Reserved)
Pull to refresh (or the refresh button); the list reloads

screens.name: offline-submit
screens.app: Android Emulator (x64 AVD) running Contoso Requests
steps: Prepare started the emulator and the three services; deploy and start the app: dotnet build src/Contoso.Mobile -f net10.0-android -t:Run
Clear the app data first (Settings > Apps > Contoso Requests > Storage) so the outbox is empty; Do Not Disturb on
Turn on airplane mode (quick settings, or: adb shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable)
Open the form: Title 'Standing desks', Department FIN, Budget 12000, Requested by alex.demo@contoso.com; tap Submit
The result line says: 'Saved on this device. It will be sent when you are back online.'

screens.app: Android Emulator running Contoso Requests, plus a PowerShell window
steps: Optional first: stop the Budget service to see the row stay Pending, then start it again

teardown: $sdk = if ($env:ANDROID_HOME) { $env:ANDROID_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk' }; $adb = Join-Path $sdk 'platform-tools\adb.exe'; if (Test-Path $adb) { & $adb emu kill }

dotnet build tests/Contoso.Mobile.Tests -v q --nologo; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'dotnet build failed' }   # no MAUI workload or emulator needed for the tests project
